MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory card and reader bundle fits my repeated purchases of removable storage and ways to access it, provided the card works with my devices.",
    "The Fire TV Stick offers a useful new function for my existing television: streaming. I would consider it for that purpose, rather than for its 4K capability."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo displays, speakers, and smart plug assume I want Alexa features, but my purchases have mostly addressed practical storage, connection, mounting, and power needs.",
    "A home monitoring camera does not follow from buying photography accessories, and desktop RAM does not meet the same need as removable memory cards.",
    "The USB-C cables could be useful only if I have compatible devices; my history of buying other cable types does not establish that need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in a wider range of Amazon devices, although those devices serve different purposes.",
    "Broad similarities such as memory, cameras, car electronics, or power seem to have outweighed what I actually use each purchase for."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy accessories that support equipment I already own, so the connection type, fit, and supported storage format matter to my choices.",
    "My car mounts and cables suggest practical installation needs, not a desire for voice assistance, just as my power strips suggest more outlets rather than home automation.",
    "My recent lens cap purchase adds evidence of continued interest in maintaining photography equipment."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my storage and television needs but too often treated general electronics interest as a reason to suggest unrelated smart devices."
}
